source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What should a support workflow check after applying a repair?

options.text: The affected object and its requested behavior.
options.feedback: Read back what changed and check the behavior the user needed. This establishes more than the fact that an operation was attempted.

options.text: The wording of the original repair request alone.
options.feedback: The request identifies the desired result but does not show the current state. Verification requires observing the affected object.

options.text: The confidence of the agent that proposed the repair.
options.feedback: Confidence is generated output, not evidence of the repair. Check the actual saved result and behavior.

options.text: The success record of the same repair on a prior case.
options.feedback: A documented case helps select a procedure, but its past success does not establish the current result. Read back the object changed in this run.
